[[T.D.S. Organization]] |owner_other = [[Serum Zero]] |first_appearance = [[Intermediate Mode]] |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile Enthrallist] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Mankind has been a tumor to this garden of Eden.
Now there's entire species erased, millions of acres defaced.
But yet, {{QuoteDiff|Jetzt ist es an mir, die Menschheit auszulöschen!|(Translated: now it's my turn to wipe out humanity!)}}|'''Patient Zero''' in its trailer}} }} ==Description== '''Patient Zero''' is the main antagonist of [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode in Tower Defense Simulator, and according to the game's storyline, he is the mastermind behind [[Serum Zero]] and the orchestrator of the zombie apocalypse. He was once a human virologist named '''Dr. Herrschaft''', but after experimenting on himself with [[Serum Zero]], he transformed himself into a zombie, later being dubbed "''Patient Zero''" by the [[T.D.S. Organization]].{{InlineQuote|Wait... What if '''Dr. Herrschaft''' is '''Patient Zero'''? I mean, it wasn't until after the zombies started taking over the cities, and if he were to get infected it wouldn't surprise me he would be first in contact.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 25 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} ==Personality== '''Patient Zero''' can be concluded to be an extremely mentally unstable individual from his appearance in the '''Patient Zero''' trailer, given from the fact that he supposedly locked away his zombified coworkers in experiment rooms within the Oasis X Enterprise laboratory, and also from the fact that his prime motive for orchestrating the zombie apocalypse is from his seeming hatred of humanity for abusing the environment of the [[Overworld]].https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vk7eFSlSzNA It is unknown if '''Patient Zero''' was as psychotic as he was in his past, but it can still be assumed that he harbored either a level of malice or indifference to human lives, as in his past he was discovered to be secretly experimenting on hospital patients.{{InlineQuote|It seems a medical specialist named Dr. Herrschaft used to work at a local town hospital, but was fired for experimenting on his patients.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 22 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} ==Abilities & Characteristics== {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" ! colspan="2" |Other |- |'''Bio-enhancement''': Since [[Serum Zero]] is compared to other bio-enhancing drugs produced by Oasis X Enterprise, it could be assumed that [[Serum Zero]] was originally supposed to be another bio-enhancing serum before it was repurposed by '''Patient Zero''' into his zombification formula. It would be fair to assume that the original bio-enhancing properties of [[Serum Zero]] would be kept, giving zombies, and therefore '''Patient Zero''', an array of superhuman physical traits. |[[File:Patientzeroyapsesh.PNG|200px|center|thumb|"''Not listed here are our standard stabalizers used in other chemical Bio-enhancing serums.''"]] |- |'''Zombification''': '''Patient Zero's''' condition of being a zombie is unique compared to others, mainly that he underwent zombification while he was still alive, unlike other zombies that have seemingly been reanimated by [[Serum Zero]], if they are presumed to be undead. |[[File:PatientZeroTransformation.gif|200px|center|thumb|The moment of '''Patient Zero's''' zombification.]]
|} ==Story== ===Unknown=== '''Patient Zero''', back when he was known as '''Dr. Herrschaft''', used to work at a hospital as a virologist. His work led him to study viruses that were thousands of years old,{{InlineQuote|According to the documents gathered so far, he spent time as a virologist who worked on viruses that were thousands of years old. That's insane.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 22 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} one virus of note caused the rapid repairing and multiplication of damaged cells.{{InlineQuote|That healing technology is based off of a virus that forces damaged cells to repair and multiply, and that was the center of his work. Instead of losing all that research, TDS took possession of it and had Medic create a healing particle beam. Woah.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 24 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} However, he was fired from the hospital after it was discovered that he was experimenting on patients. '''Dr. Herrschaft''' eventually loses his license and subsequently all of his research, however, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] takes possession of some of it for their own use.{{InlineQuote|That healing technology is based off of a virus that forces damaged cells to repair and multiply, and that was the center of his work. Instead of losing all that research, TDS took possession of it and had Medic create a healing particle beam. Woah.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 24 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} It was after this time that '''Dr. Herrschaft''' moved back to his hometown to continue work on the cell multiplication virus.{{InlineQuote|From my guess, '''Dr. Herrschaft''' lost his license and went to his hometown to work on the virus once more. This date is right around the time the zombie outbreak happened!|[[Professor V]] on Wave 25 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} ===Employment at Oasis X Enterprise=== It was most likely after his firing that '''Dr. Herrschaft''' had joined, or was recruited by Oasis X Enterprise, where he would work with his fellow scientists to synthesize the prototypes of [[Serum Zero]]. Accidental exposure to these prototypes led several scientists to be transformed into [[Ghoul|Ghouls]].[[File:GhoulCA.jpg|thumb|288x288px]] Other zombies such as [[Reaver]]s, [[Failed Experiment]]s and [[Living Experiment]]s would have also been created from these prototypes. The virus responsible for zombification was most likely introduced into [[Serum Zero]] during his time working with Oasis X Enterprise. It is is unknown how '''Dr. Herrschaft's''' coworkers or Oasis X Enterprise would have responded to this development, but given that his coworkers are mysteriously absent up to the time of the '''Patient Zero''' trailer, it can be concluded that '''Dr. Herrschaft''' had experimented on all of them. ===Patient Zero Trailer=== '''Dr. Herrschaft''' manages to mysteriously acquire a [[God Cube]] fragment, which he uses to perfect the final version of [[Serum Zero]]. He then tests the final version of himself, transforming into [[Patient Zero]]. ===Unknown=== '''Patient Zero''' releases [[Serum Zero]] in various cities, beginning the zombie apocalypse.{{InlineQuote|I mean, it wasn't until after the zombies started taking over the cities...|[[Professor V]] on Wave 25 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} ===Hacker Trailer=== '''Patient Zero''' attempts to have his zombies release [[Serum Zero]] in [[Cyber City]], but they are stopped by the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. ===Intermediate Mode=== The [[T.D.S. Organization]] fights off a horde of zombies, culminating in the appearance of '''Patient Zero''' on the battlefield, where he is promptly defeated by them, and his [[God Cube]] fragment, presumably the same one he used to synthesize [[Serum Zero]], is taken away from his hands.Listed in the [[God Cube]] merger video as one of the obtained fragments. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Zwhcp5Gpds ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Appearances}} Patientzerohuman.jpg|'''Patient Zero''' as a human. Patientzerocorrupted.jpg|'''Patient Zero''' as a zombie. }} ==Trivia== *The {{Color|Hexscape|Garage Band}} [[DJ Booth]]'s song lyrics suggest that '''Patient Zero''' could have ties to the [[Children of Exo]]. **''"Composed from a cult, the chemist engulfed"''https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8rrbecN5XYY ==Notes== {{StoryNavBox}}
